_note: Data for the P3.2 / P3.3 carrier base package on the Thinking core (owner rulings 302 A, 306 A, 333 B). Every identity that a source cell already carries (rows, audio seconds, split identity, scorers, units) is READ from the source cell by the derive and is NOT repeated here; this file holds only what no source cell can supply: the source-cell names, the derived-id stems, the pins of the Thinking packet artifacts, the cost inputs and the sealed-prompt fit observations.

cost.basis: Thinking SLURP measured per-contact seconds at np4 (coordinator brief, NX-T R2b read): Perception about 59 s, Solver about 64 s; the delivering SLURP lock row is 123 s = 59 + 64. A2T is a one-node tool-call answer and takes the Perception figure; the Earnings window transcript (about 275 answer tokens) takes the Solver figure. Cross-check from the 266-E bare-core direct Thinking arm (22.75 s per contact mean, 1,032 completion tokens, 0.02298 s per token per slot) and from the sealed Instruct contact latencies: the all-contacts-reason-to-the-budget envelope is the Instruct latency plus 0.02298 x 3,072 = 71.5 s (A2T) and 82.4 s (Earnings), registered as the upper envelope in the facts and NOT as the ceiling.

instruct_contact_seconds_source.a2t: SAEA-A2T-STAGE3-AA-PAIRED-400-A-V1 COST channel, 400 contacts, mean client latency 0.94 s at np3
instruct_contact_seconds_source.e21: SAEA-E21-NATIVE-WINDOW-DIRECT-SUB10-V1 COST channel, 342 contacts, mean 11.85 s at np4
instruct_contact_seconds_source.e22: no sealed Earnings-22 run exists; the Earnings-21 native-window figure is the proxy (same 90 s window form, same instruction)

fit_observations.limit_basis: slot 24,576 - operational reserve 3,072 - completion cap 4,096 - special reserve 2 = 17,406 (thinking_system_family.PROMPT_LIMIT_THINKING)

a2t.note: includes the 654.6 s synthesis-defect row; the Instruct geometry was np3 x 32,768

e22.run: none (proxy: the Earnings-21 native-window maximum, same 90 s window form and instruction)
